title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-18

ai_review.summary: Lovely, quiet audience recording that makes a less‑favored show sound interesting
ai_review.review: The taper captured an unusually clear and low‑noise audience tape, which the reviewer describes as ‘lovely sound’ and quieter than typical crowd recordings. While the performance itself isn’t highlighted as a favorite, the high‑quality audience source makes it worth listening to.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic five‑star review praises the recording quality but offers little about the musical performance, leading to a modest overall rating that balances an excellent tape with an average show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Taper positioned in a relatively quiet spot, resulting in clear, low‑noise sound that many find more interesting than board recordings.
